cards.snippet: But now many nations have assembled against you, saying, “Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.”

cards.card_text: Now he turns to one more city: "Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!" Friend, when a prophet's been calling out every city on the map and then says ONE MORE, nobody in the room is breathing.
cards.verse_text: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
cards.snippet: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

cards.card_text: defiled holy clean
cards.verse_text: So Haggai asked, “If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these, does it become defiled?” “Yes, it becomes defiled,” the priests answered.

cards.card_text: Then Haggai brings it home, speaking for the LORD: "So it is with this people and this nation before Me…" Holy doesn't rub off but defiled does, which is me with dough in my mustache, because ONE swipe and the whole bakery is covered.
cards.verse_text: So Haggai asked, “If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these, does it become defiled?” “Yes, it becomes defiled,” the priests answered.

cards.card_text: Speaking for the LORD, Haggai says "So it is with this people and this nation before Me…" True or false: the LORD says every work of their hands is defiled too.
cards.verse_text: Then Haggai replied, “So it is with this people and this nation before Me, declares the LORD, and so it is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.
cards.snippet: …is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.

cards.card_text: And whatever they offer there is defiled.
cards.verse_text: Then Haggai replied, “So it is with this people and this nation before Me, declares the LORD, and so it is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.
cards.snippet: …is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.

cards.card_text: defiled leftover borrowed
cards.verse_text: By presenting defiled food on My altar.
cards.snippet: By presenting defiled food on My altar.

cards.card_text: So they ask AGAIN: "How have we defiled You?" These men are like the dead batteries I shared that junk drawer with, still swearing they've got plenty of charge left.
cards.verse_text: By presenting defiled food on My altar.
cards.snippet: By presenting defiled food on My altar.

cards.card_text: But these priests call His table defiled and its food contemptible, and they say, "Oh, what a nuisance!" That's the voice people use when the alarm goes off on a Monday, and they're using it about the table of the LORD.
cards.verse_text: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is contemptible.’ You also say: ‘Oh, what a nuisance!’ And you turn up your nose at it,” says the LORD of Hosts.
cards.snippet: …you profane it when you say, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is contemptible.’ You also say:…

cards.card_text: Jesus tells the crowd what really defiles a man.
cards.verse_text: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”
cards.snippet: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”

cards.card_text: Jesus says the things that come out of the mouth come from the ___, and these things defile a man.
cards.verse_text: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.
cards.snippet: …come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.

cards.card_text: He says eating with unwashed hands defiles a man.
cards.verse_text: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”
cards.snippet: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”

cards.card_text: They see some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled, that is, unwashed.
cards.verse_text: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus, and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
cards.snippet: …and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.

cards.card_text: Jesus tells the crowd that something can't defile a man at all.
cards.verse_text: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”
cards.snippet: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are…

cards.card_text: Jesus tells the crowd it's the things that come out of a man that defile him.
cards.verse_text: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”
cards.snippet: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are…

cards.card_text: All these evils come from within, Jesus says, and these are what defile a man.
cards.verse_text: All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.”
cards.snippet: All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.”

cards.card_text: So they won't be defiled before the Passover So the guards won't turn them away So the people outside can hear the trial
cards.verse_text: By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
cards.snippet: …morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.

cards.card_text: Their conscience is weak, Paul says, so it's defiled.
cards.verse_text: And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
cards.snippet: And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.

cards.card_text: So Paul wraps it up and calls them beloved: since we have these promises, let's cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, and friend, that's not a quick wipe of the counter, that's the WHOLE kitchen.
cards.verse_text: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.” Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
cards.snippet: …since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

cards.card_text: But to the defiled and unbelieving, ___ is pure.
cards.verse_text: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure.
cards.snippet: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure.

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says the minds of the defiled are still clean, even though their consciences aren't.
cards.verse_text: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure.
cards.snippet: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure.

cards.card_text: Cause trouble and defile many Wither and bear no fruit Stay small and hurt no one
cards.verse_text: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.
cards.snippet: …and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.

cards.card_text: In the same way, they defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
cards.verse_text: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
cards.snippet: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.

cards.card_text: He says these are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins.
cards.verse_text: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins.
